superseded_or_not_current.reason: The Belgian inter-Orthodox page retains the older St James listing in Uccle. The current 2026 ROCOR diocesan directory identifies the body at the same Uccle address as St Job Memorial Church. The current St Job row is published without duplicating the older name.

superseded_or_not_current.name: All Saints Romanian Orthodox parish in Namur
superseded_or_not_current.reason: The older Belgium directory places All Saints in Namur. The parish moved to Huldenberg in 2017, its own current site identifies Huldenberg, and the current Metropolis list publishes the Huldenberg parish. The Huldenberg row is published once.

source_reconciliation.subject: Ecumenical Patriarchate coverage
source_reconciliation.result: The current archdiocesan parish list establishes 34 Belgium bodies. Its current other-presences page and parish page establish the Ukrainian St Michael parish in Genk, producing 35 rows. The Polish-expression Nativity parish and Arabic-expression St Ignatius parish remain under the Ecumenical Patriarchate and are not duplicated as Polish or Antiochian jurisdictions.

source_reconciliation.subject: Moscow Patriarchate Belgium coverage
source_reconciliation.result: The current Moscow diocesan directory lists 18 churches, parishes, chapels, and monasteries. The Belgian inter-Orthodox page is shorter and omits the current Kortrijk body. The parent diocese's current 18-item directory governs.

source_reconciliation.subject: Russian Tradition coverage
source_reconciliation.result: The current archdiocesan directory establishes four Belgium bodies, including Antwerp and Banneux. The shorter Belgian inter-Orthodox page lists only Brussels and Liege. The current parent directory's four-body union governs.

source_reconciliation.subject: Serbian Western Europe coverage
source_reconciliation.result: The current Serbian Benelux directory establishes six Belgium bodies. The Belgian inter-Orthodox page names only Brussels and Antwerp. All six current diocesan bodies are preserved.

source_reconciliation.subject: Romanian Orthodox coverage
source_reconciliation.result: The current Metropolis page establishes 22 archdiocesan parishes and missions. The official Belgium directory and current monastery schedule establish the Protection monastery in Namur. The official Belgium directory and the chapel's current site establish the directly patriarchal St Parascheva chapel, which is published under the Church of Romania rather than the western archdiocese.

source_reconciliation.subject: Bulgarian Orthodox coverage
source_reconciliation.result: The Bulgarian Patriarchate directory establishes the Brussels St Clement community. The Antwerp community's own current site records its official conversion from a mission into the St Zlata church community in May 2026 and publishes its 2026 schedule. Both are current bodies under the same diocese.

source_reconciliation.subject: Macedonian Orthodox coverage
source_reconciliation.result: The current European Diocese page establishes exactly one Belgium church community. The current state diaspora report identifies it as the Holy Prophet Elijah and Archangel Michael community in Brussels and documents worship there in November 2025. One row is published.

source_reconciliation.subject: UOC Brussels parish and worship sites
source_reconciliation.result: The 2026 official report confirms the All Venerable Fathers of the Kyiv Caves parish as current. The official foundation report establishes regular worship at Anderlecht and Kraainem. The parish row and its second recurring worship site are both preserved.
